reddit.title: Improving Performance: Cutting Flowing Water Cost
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing water interacts with the game world in Provincia. By adjusting the way we handle wet cells, we've reduced the script time for a flowing 64×64 lake from about 20 ms to approximately 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay and less lag when interacting with water. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Provincia Update: Enhanced Water Performance
steam.body: We're excited to announce a performance update that significantly reduces the cost of managing flowing water in Provincia. This optimization means smoother gameplay and less lag when interacting with lakes and rivers. For a detailed breakdown of the changes, visit our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
